$comment: Illustrated Career sleeves: earned card backs like art/specs/sleeve.json, but a whole carved scene instead of one emblem. They are catalog sleeves (kind sleeve) and go to the same folder, so they draw like any sleeve. After drawing, run `python3 art/fit_cards.py public/career-art/sleeve/<ids>.webp`.
style: Illustrated card backs: one upright card back per cell, front view, all the same 5:7 rectangle with slightly rounded corners and straight edges; nothing sticks out past the card's edge. The whole card is ONE flat solid field of the accent ink named by the subject (printed like a solid letterpress block, with its speckle), with an ornamental ivory border inset from the edge, and inside it a whole carved ivory scene that fills the card: richer and more detailed than a single emblem, still bold enough to read at small size. Symmetrical where the scene allows, since a back is also seen upside down across the table. It must read as an original premium card back, never as any existing trading card game's back: no oval frame around a logo, no five coloured dots, no banner with a word. Each card fills about 90% of its cell's height.
spare: an illustrated card back in deep green-black accent ink with an ornamental ivory border and a carved ivory compass rose
